name: MINT Societe anonyme
summary: MINT Société anonyme provides renewable electricity in France. It offers telecommunication and mobile phone services. The company was formerly known as Budget Telecom S.A. and changed its name to MINT Société anonyme in January 2020. MINT Société anonyme was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Montpellier, France. MINT Société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Mercure Energie.
